title: The Witch Cake
sentences: A cake baked with urine was fed to a dog to find a witch.
It happened in February 1692, at the home of Reverend Samuel Parris.
A neighbor, Mary Sibley, suggested this bit of English folk magic.
Rye meal was mixed with the afflicted girls’ urine and baked.
The family’s enslaved servants, Tituba and John Indian, were involved.
Parris was furious and later blamed it for letting the Devil loose in the village.
caption:
A cake baked with urine was fed to a dog to find a witch. It made everything worse.
